## Checklist

- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`
- [ ] If this is a new feature or architecture change, I opened an issue first (bug fixes, providers, docs & translations are exempt — send those straight in)
- [ ] My PR does not include personal data (CV, email, real names, scan results, or pipeline data)
- [ ] I ran `node test-all.mjs` and all tests pass
- [ ] I ran `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` in `web/` when the web application changed
- [ ] My changes respect `DATA_CONTRACT.md` and do not commit user-layer files
- [ ] New hosted data access is authenticated and tenant-scoped on the server
- [ ] No application, form submission, or message bypasses explicit user approval

Thank you for helping make RoleLinked safer and easier to use.
